title: Personal Injury Professionals Networking Mixer
summary: An evening at Yard House centered on new introductions, sponsor visibility, and stronger relationships across South Florida's personal injury community.
description: The February mixer at Merrick Park set the tone for the year. It was the first event where the room felt genuinely self-sustaining — people arriving already knowing three or four others from previous months.
It's the venue people have asked to return to more than any other, which is why November is heading back.

flyer.alt: Personal Injury Professionals Networking Mixer flyer, February 26 2026, Coral Gables

recap.headline: The month the community started running itself.
body: Ninety-seven people at Merrick Park, and for the first time a majority arrived already knowing someone else in the room. That's the point at which a networking series stops being an event and starts being a community.
Thank you to The MRI Guys, Law Offices of Mario E. Lopez, Align the Spine, In-Check, and Realign Chiropractic Center for the support.

photos.alt: Attendees at the February networking mixer
photos.caption: Merrick Park, February.

comments.author: Adriana Kessler
comments.body: Walked in and immediately saw four people I'd met in January. That's when I stopped thinking of these as one-offs.

comments.author: Julio Mendes
comments.body: Yard House was a great venue. Loud in spots but the back area worked well.
